question: You decided direct_outlets (flow-002, confidence 0.81) with required criteria clearances, support, escapes, counterpress, regression and clips. Here is the before/after evidence from the same 24 scenarios (3 seeds). Accept, revise or investigate?

criteria.clearances: Direct side clearances at most 40 per match and long passes 50-90 per match.
criteria.support: At least 2.5 direct-side teammates within 15 m of the landing point.
criteria.escapes: Short escapes in at least 20% of pressed build-ups.
criteria.counterpress: Counter-presses starting with fewer than 3 nearby players at most 30%.
criteria.regression: All existing suites pass, finite positions, zero assignment violations.
criteria.clips: New clips of the same passage types show the change.

evidence.implementation: sim.js: directOutlet() aims balls from deep at the target man / a forward runner with a win chance from aerial ability, the nearest defender and nearby team-mates; a blind clearance is only a last resort in real danger (deep, heavy pressure) and is aimed at the outlet or the near channel; secondBallSupport() sends 3 team-mates to the landing zone (behind, inside, beyond) and the defending side's 2 nearest midfielders drop goal-side to contest; any lofted pass now includes the aerial contest at the landing point in its risk; a free short option close by under pressure in the own half is valued higher.

regressionSuites.value: 9/9 suites: jev-lead, defending, transitions, intent, engine-qa, audit --strict, 12-match --strict, shape (browser), live (browser)

clips.value: docs/flow-clips/after-direct-outlets: runners now gather around the landing point; clearances are aimed

evidence.analysis: Blind clearances fell from 108 to 32 and the counter-press now starts with 3+ players in 73% of losses. But the direct side now keeps the ball much more (416 -> 662 passes) and plays 174 aimed long passes per match, mostly from the middle third under pressure after winning a second ball, so long passes exceed the 50-90 target; second balls are won 74% (real top-flight duels are closer to 50%). Global pass volume in the engine is about 1.4x real, which inflates every absolute pass count. Support 2.3 and short escapes 15% are just below their targets.
